description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for user management in a REST API, including user listing, creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion, with role-based access control and activity logging.

methods.name: requireAdmin(req, res, next)
methods.description: Middleware function to ensure the user has 'admin' role.

methods.name: GET /users
methods.description: Handler to list users, accessible only by admin.

methods.name: POST /users
methods.description: Handler to create a new user, accessible only by admin.

methods.name: GET /users/:id
methods.description: Handler to retrieve a specific user's details, accessible by admin or the user themselves.

methods.name: PUT /users/:id
methods.description: Handler to update user details, accessible by admin or the user themselves, with restrictions.

methods.name: DELETE /users/:id
methods.description: Handler to delete a user, accessible only by admin.
